limitations: Same-session serial one-thread measurements; no general speed claim.
Ordinary identity timing was 15.6% higher in this run versus 3.1% baseline drift; mixed Poisson was 10.0% higher versus 3.3% drift. These local timing regressions remain visible for review.
RSS is cumulative process peak, including imports, warmup, all prior cases, serialization and untimed diagnostics.
Pickle bytes measure the serializable model graph, not full native/global retained heap.
Corrected phase-I fit does more work than the falsely converged baseline and returns no invalid means.

baseline-before.measurement_notes:
Seeded complete-fit receipts; run baseline, head, then baseline serially.

Data/model construction and one warmup are excluded from fit timings. Diagnostics
come from a separate untimed fit. Peak RSS is cumulative for the whole process;
pickle size covers the retained model graph, not native/global caches or heap size.
Write receipts outside the repository. This script makes no speedup judgement.
baseline-before.nonfinite_policy: non-finite scalars become strings; JSON NaN is forbidden
